Description: Levels is a modern style barbershop that provides world-class traditional barbering services. We offer ladies and gentlemen an environment where customers can come to relax, network with friends and/or colleagues, and experience high quality grooming as well as customized services. The combination of quality service and a comforting, modernist atmosphere will establish Levels as the desired location for barbering services in the area. Our target customer base will be within the ages of 18 and 45. We are dedicated to growing our client base and making Levels a staple business in downtown Berkeley.
